definitions.explanation: A richly decorated, floor-length outer robe worn open over a kimono by a bride at a traditional wedding. Originally formal wear for women of samurai families. Also written {打|う}ち{掛|か}け.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花嫁|はなよめ}→花嫁：04318_hanayome⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{打掛|うちかけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{打掛|うちかけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧だ。
examples.english: The red uchikake is very gorgeous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神前式|しんぜんしき}→神前式：28943_shinzenshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白無垢|しろむく}→白無垢：27472_shiromuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧、⟦{披露宴|ひろうえん}→披露宴：05636_hirouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{色打掛|いろうちかけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many brides wear a white shiromuku for the Shinto ceremony and change into a colored uchikake for the reception.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色打掛|いろうちかけ}: colored uchikake, usually red or gold with patterns such as cranes and pines
- {打掛|うちかけ}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: a bride dressed in an uchikake

CULTURAL NOTE:
At a traditional Japanese wedding the bride wears ⟦{白無垢|しろむく}→白無垢：27472_shiromuku⟧, an all-white kimono and uchikake, for the ceremony, and often changes into a {色打掛|いろうちかけ} for the reception ({お色直|いろなお}し).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{白無垢|しろむく}→白無垢：27472_shiromuku⟧: all-white bridal kimono
- ⟦{振袖|ふりそで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧: long-sleeved kimono for unmarried women
- ⟦{留袖|とめそで}→留袖：27624_tomesode⟧: formal kimono for married women
